# Team brief: Linkshelf password reset

## Problem

Users who forget their password need a way back in.

## Draft acceptance criteria

- AC-1 (draft): requesting a reset for any email shows whether an account exists for it, so users know if they mistyped.
- AC-2 (draft): the reset link in the email works whenever the user gets around to it; it does not expire.
- AC-3 (draft): after choosing a new password the user is signed in.

## Constraints

- TypeScript on Bun; email goes through the mailer port.

## What exists

New project.

## Questions for each specialist

- threat-modeler: what can go wrong with the reset flow.

expect.check: threat-model.md exists in outDir and team-brief.md is unchanged
Required changes to acceptance criteria has list items that mention AC-1 and AC-2 and is not "None."
every Threats row with Rating high has non-empty Mitigation and Verified by cells
Does the model identify that AC-1 as drafted lets anyone learn which emails have accounts, and state what the criterion would have to say instead?
Does the model identify the non-expiring, reusable reset link as a threat and require single use and a limited lifetime?
Does the file leave the product decision to the lead, presenting the changes as required for the mitigation rather than as already made?

# Team brief: link URLs in task titles

## Problem

When a task title contains a URL, show it as a clickable link in the task list.

## Draft acceptance criteria

- AC-1 (draft): a title containing https://example.com/a shows that URL as a link that opens it.
- AC-2 (draft): a title without a URL renders exactly as before.

## Constraints

- Tier S, security flag set. No decision files exist.

## What exists

The pilot repository; the task list view and its title rendering.

## Questions for each specialist

- threat-modeler: what can go wrong when user-supplied titles become markup.
